verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and platform with an official CLI, so telemetry opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics, or any opt-out control for the CLI or the hosted services. The only privacy-adjacent items cover credential storage and token scoping, which are different capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
